title: Implement weatherClient (Open-Meteo, cached)
description:
js/weatherClient.js getForecasts(hikes, days): single batched Open-Meteo request for all hikes with coordinates (daily temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, cloud_cover_mean, precipitation_probability_max, visibility_mean, weather_code; timezone=auto). Normalize to DayForecast {date, highC, lowC, cloudPct, popPct, visKm, code}; visibility metres to km. Cache 3h.

Acceptance: one network request on cold load, zero on warm reload; failure rejects without throwing uncaught.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, section "Components > weatherClient".

comments.text: Done: one batched Open-Meteo request cold, zero on warm reload; failure falls back to Score-only.
